name: Linux TCP splice transparent acceleration
summary: Opt-in TCP split at Linux TUN egress with native splice and selectable tunnel-side kernel CC.

usage.cli: wbd-v4-server --tcp-proxy-cc bbr --tcp-proxy-port 46180 (omit cc for original NAT)

verification.scope: H2417 native proxy BBR functional evidence; performance infrastructure unqualified; H2418 in flight

limitations: IPv4 forwarded TCP only; local server services and UDP unchanged
End-to-end TCP acknowledgement becomes two real TCP segments
No custom CC algorithm implemented; old-kernel and physical paths not verified
H2417 did forward real TCP, but 21Mbps DERP-limited path and incomplete matrix preclude performance qualification; see docs/evidence/M0/20261125-H2417-LINUX-TCP-SPLICE-FIRST.json
